name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle designed to travel on no more than three wheels, which for registration includes motorized bicycles and scooters; an electric two-wheeler whose motor exceeds five brake horsepower (3,750 W) is a full motorcycle rather than a motor-driven cycle. Defined by Wyoming Statutes §31-1-101(a)(xv)(E) and §31-5-102(a)(xxii), as compiled in May 2026.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle and no more than three wheels on the ground; a sidecar for one passenger is allowed
Its motor produces more than five brake horsepower (3,750 W); one at or under that is a motor-driven cycle
Not a moped, motorized skateboard, multipurpose vehicle, electric bicycle or off-road recreational vehicle
Riders need a class M motorcycle license or endorsement
Riders and passengers under 18 must wear a fastened helmet on public roads
Its headlamp must be on at all times, including in daylight, and a passenger needs footrests
Registered with the county treasurer and must carry liability insurance
No lane splitting, and no more than two abreast in a lane
